findings.title: Keep script-injection protection off deprecated environment options
findings.body: Line 45 replaces direct Jinja autoescape configuration with Starlette's deprecated **env_options forwarding. Installed Starlette 0.52.1 explicitly warns to use a preconfigured Environment. A render probe confirms escaping works today; no current XSS bypass was demonstrated. However, the protection now depends on continued support for that deprecated path. Docker installs unbounded dependencies from pyproject.toml without uv.lock, so that dependency is not stable across builds. If escaping lapses, interpolations such as entry.name and entry.detail in templates/partials/search_log.html:19 become script-injection sinks; removal of the keyword path could instead prevent startup.
findings.recommendation: Restore jinja2.Environment(loader=jinja2.FileSystemLoader(str(TEMPLATES_DIR)), autoescape=True) and pass it through Jinja2Templates(env=...).

next_steps: Restore the supported explicit environment configuration.
